title.value: SeroTracker: a global SARS-CoV-2 seroprevalence dashboard
title.justification: The title clearly represents the focus and content of the paper, which is introducing SeroTracker, a dashboard for tracking SARS-CoV-2 seroprevalence globally.
title.quote: SeroTracker: a global SARS-CoV-2 seroprevalence dashboard

analysis.description: The paper introduces SeroTracker, a dashboard designed to aggregate and visualize global SARS-CoV-2 seroprevalence estimates. It collates data from serological studies to provide insights into COVID-19 infection rates, aiming to assist researchers and policymakers in understanding the pandemic's scope and helping with decision-making.

type.justification: The paper discusses the creation and utility of a real-world tool (SeroTracker) and its application in compiling and analyzing empirical data from serological studies.
type.quote: To address this need, we created SeroTracker, a custom-built dashboard that systematically monitors and synthesises findings from hundreds of global SARS-CoV-2 serological studies.

name.justification: The research primarily deals with seroprevalence and monitoring the spread of SARS-CoV-2, which falls under the domain of epidemiology.
name.quote: As the initial phase of the COVID-19 pandemic passes its peak in many countries, serological studies are becoming increasingly important in guiding public health responses.

name.justification: The work is a public health endeavor to track seroprevalence which can inform policy-making and health responses.
name.quote: SeroTracker has proven useful to researchers, policy makers, and public health officials.

name.justification: The dashboard includes visualization features to present data in an accessible manner, showing it is connected to data visualization field.
name.quote: Dashboards that visualise COVID-19 cases confirmed by diagnostic testing have been pivotal in enabling policy makers and researchers to monitor the pandemic.
